posts.text:
Half my ideas only get sharper when I’m forced to explain them to someone. Annie says she often doesn’t know what she believes until she says it out loud. Same.

Funny that most AI products are built to answer for us. Gakku, the AI learning app she co-founded, is built around
posts.quoted: We’ve raised $51 million to rethink how kids learn with AI. Our bet: conversational learning. Language isn’t just how we communicate. It’s how we think. That’s the idea behind Gakku, our AI learning coach. The learning process itself is the product—not something to automate away.
